t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion of 2015, which is recorded as a destroyed structure, so it is no longer standing. It was designed by two Spanish architects, Lucía Cano and José Selgas, who together founded the Madrid studio SelgasCano. Their work is known for bold use of colour, for experimenting with new materials, and for thinking carefully about how a building sits in its surrounding landscape. Those ideas are the reason they are named here.
